goal: Maintain the common-foundation route for shared substrate changes.
description: Use docs/plan/Styio-Common-Foundation-Plan.md before feature work when shared workflow, docs gate, tool/skill registry, test harness, service contract, source layout, CMake, or platform substrate changes are required.

acceptance_criteria.text: Any feature plan that discovers shared substrate work lists this plan in its prerequisites before implementation starts.
The owning workflow, runbook, registry, generated index, and at least one regression gate are updated in the same checkpoint as the foundation change.
python scripts/docs-audit.py, python scripts/workflow-scheduler.py check, and python scripts/tool-skill-registry-gate.py pass for foundation changes.
